# Human Heart

> Warm, accessible individual Gestalt counselling — online, in English and Russian.

Genia is a Gestalt counsellor offering short-term and long-term individual therapy sessions online. Areas of focus include grief, relationship difficulties, life transitions, and existential questions. Sessions are available in English and Russian.

## Book a session

To book a session, visit: https://humanheart.life

## Contact

For questions or to get in touch directly: be@humanheart.life

## About Gestalt therapy

Gestalt therapy is a present-centred, humanistic approach that emphasises awareness, personal responsibility, and direct experience in the therapeutic relationship. Sessions explore what is happening right now — in emotions, body sensations, and relational patterns — rather than focusing primarily on the past.

## Language

Sessions are conducted in English or Russian. The website is fully bilingual.

## Sessions

- Individual therapy sessions (50–90 minutes)
- Short-term and long-term formats
- Online via video call

## Pricing

Session fees vary by type. Some sessions are offered on a solidarity (sliding-scale) basis. See the booking page for current options.
